title: The build-floor correction re-dispatches Build for a defect in a TDD-owned predicate, which Build cannot fix
summary: Cycle 1761 (wave 42): the build handoff floor rejected the deliverable because TDD's own predicate TestC1761_009_OnlyTargetPackagesTouched stayed red; the predicate was unsatisfiable (an allow-list scope fence that excluded the pipeline's required explanation document and eval). The correction loop re-dispatched Build twice with the same byte-identical predicate failure and the cycle sealed FAIL. Build may not edit go/acs/cycle<N>/ (TDD owns the RED contract), so the loop could never converge (retro lesson inst-L1761b).
fix: When a build-floor failure is a TDD-authored predicate in go/acs/cycle<N>/ and the failure repeats byte-identically across a Build correction (or the predicate's premise is contradicted by a pipeline-required artifact), route the correction to TDD (re-author the predicate) or to the operator — never a second Build re-dispatch for the same predicate defect.
acceptance: A repeated TDD-predicate failure at the build floor routes to TDD, not Build (red on the cycle-1761 shape)
A predicate failure Build can fix still corrects at Build
